thesis: The podcast introduces LVMH as the 15th largest company in the world by market cap, noting its 20X growth over 20 years and its ownership of 75 brands across fashion, spirits, and travel. The hosts explain that the episode will explore how Bernard Arnault turned $15 million of capital in 1985 into a $200 billion fortune through unique deal-making and brand management strategies that differ from standard business models.
